messages:
sophie_r: Hi folks 1 1 I got married last week! Want to add my spouse to medical + dental. Can we make the coverage effective on our wedding date (6/1)? Also spouse is currently on COBRA from their previous job 5. Any docs you need?

annelise (People Ops): Huge congrats, Sophie!! :confetti_ball: You have a 30-day special enrollment window from your marriage date to add a spouse. We can request an enrollment effective date back to 6/1 (your wedding date) as long as we submit within the window.

jamal (Benefits): Quick checklist:
- Required: marriage certificate (scan/photo) + Dependent Change Form.
- Spouse SSN is required for carrier enrollment (please include on the form).
- If spouse is on COBRA and wants to move to Redwood coverage, they can elect Redwood coverage; they should then terminate COBRA with their prior plan (COBRA is optional). Carrier acceptance sometimes takes a few days.

sophie_r: If we set effective date 6/1, will payroll deduct premiums retroactively? I dont want surprise charges.

payroll-bot: Payroll cutoff reminder: changes submitted before Wednesday 11:59pm PT go in the next run. Retro premium adjustments (employee side) will be calculated and applied. If coverage is effective earlier than submission, payroll will backdate deductions or issue a refund/charge depending on timing. Typical posting: adjustments within 1-2 pay cycles.

jamal (Benefits): Also: if spouse had COBRA and elected COBRA premiums for June, carrier may issue a refund/credit if they switch to Redwood retroactive to 6/1. Well coordinate with carrier and payroll to ensure the correct net deduction.

sophie_r: Can I also change my Health FSA election mid-year to reflect spouse addition? We were planning higher out-of-pocket coverage.

fsa-bot: FSA rules: A change in family status (marriage) is a qualifying event that usually allows a cafeteria plan election change mid-year. Submit FSA Change Form + marriage cert. Benefits will confirm whether your specific HCFSA/HSA combo allows increases; some HSAs restrict pre-tax FSA changes.

annelise (People Ops): To summarize next steps: 1) Fill Dependent Change Form (check "Marriage") and include spouse SSN and DOB. 2) Attach marriage certificate (PDF/photo). 3) If changing FSA, include FSA Change Form. 4) Email benefits@redwood.com with subject `SE: Add spouse - [Your Name]` within 30 days. We can process effective date 2026-06-01 if we receive docs by 2026-06-30.

jamal (Benefits): One more note: carriers occasionally require a signed spouse acknowledgement if moving off COBRA. Well let you know if that comes up.

sophie_r: Great. Any tax forms or impacts I should be aware of?

annelise (People Ops): Standard tax impact: pre-tax premium changes affect your taxable wages, but we dont issue extra tax forms for adding dependents. If spouse coverage changes cause retroactive withholding differences, payroll will adjust W-2s accordingly. If you have specific tax questions, consider your tax advisor.

payroll-bot: Action recorded: SE add-spouse request 1769451234 queued. Please include SSN on the form to avoid delays.

sophie_r: Thanks everyone. Uploading forms now. Appreciate the speedy help!
